```yaml
name: PR Closer

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'   # Runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:      # Allows manual trigger

jobs:
  close-stale-prs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up GitHub CLI
        uses: cli/cli@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Compute cutoff timestamp (30 days ago)
        id: cutoff
        run: echo "cutoff=$(date -d '30 days ago' +%s)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Close stale PRs
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          CUTOFF: ${{ steps.cutoff.outputs.cutoff }}
        run: |
          gh pr list --state open --json number,createdAt,author,labels | \
          jq -r --argjson cutoff "$CUTOFF" '
            map(select(
              (.createdAt | fromdateiso8601) < $cutoff
              and .author.login != "jdx"
              and (.labels | map(.name) | index("keep-open") | not)
            )) | .[] | .number' | \
          while read -r pr; do
            echo "Closing PR #$pr"
            gh pr close "$pr" --comment "This PR has been automatically closed due to inactivity. Reopen by opening a new PR or commenting."
          done
```
